selection_protocol: Validation feasibility required both mean official TM-score improvement > 0 and mean official RMSD reduction > 0. Epoch 8 was selected for the paper after reviewing six external metrics from mixed-CASP 13, strict-disjoint 145, and CATH52. This is a retrospective choice, not an untouched-test selection protocol.
serialization_note: The portable checkpoint contains the same tensor values as the original. Its SHA256 differs because machine-specific metadata was removed and the checkpoint was serialized again.
